automation.title: Automation & Background Task Scheduler (Cron)
automation.subtitle: 24/7 VDS background sync, CRO offer ladder, C_max margin shield, and shipping tracking bots

job-1.name: Automatic Etsy Order & Payment Sync
job-1.desc: Fetches new orders via Etsy Open API v3 and writes them to the VDS SQLite database.

job-2.name: Multi-Carrier Shipping Rate & Tracking Check
job-2.desc: Updates Aras Global, ShipEntegra, and Navlungo tracking statuses and prepares delivery notifications.

job-3.name: Midnight Financial Close & Telegram Briefing
job-3.desc: Calculates daily gross revenue, shipping costs, and estimated net profit and reports to the Telegram channel.

job-4.name: Weekly A/B Test Winner Selector
job-4.desc: Automatically concludes 7-day A/B tests based on statistical significance and applies the winner to the shop.

job-5.name: 🪜 CRO Abandoned Cart & Favorite 3-Tier Offer Ladder
job-5.desc: Triggers an 8% gentle nudge after 2h for favorites, a 15% recovery coupon after 24h for abandoned carts, and a Free Shipping VIP offer at 72h.

job-6.name: 🛡️ Coupon + Offsite Ads (15%) C_max Margin Protection Shield
job-6.desc: Audits active shop coupons (e.g. 30% DSFJY25) overlapping with the 15% Offsite Ads fee to warn when unit net profit drops below the target threshold.
